card.name: Words linking two parties in an interaction
card.fires_on: Small words and word parts that sit between two parties or agents, such as 'to' after talk or pass on, 'with' after coadministration, and 'ister' in co-administered. Also appears in a few scattered spots like a comma after 'daughter'.
